resources.string: Prompts and generation parameters belong to this model. Leave fields empty for service defaults.
This model or runtime does not expose this control.
Enter a number within the supported range.
Strict: block low risk and above
Balanced: block medium risk and above
Do not block by category rating
Enter the endpoint and API key to discover and select compatible realtime models automatically. Calls use native model audio.

Each category can be adjusted separately and applies to requests and replies where the model supports it. Other categories and mandatory Google safeguards can still block content. The model may also decline part of a request in its reply.
Insults, abusive bullying, or threats directed at people.
Hostility or dehumanization targeting people based on identity or group characteristics.
Graphic sexual descriptions or depictions of sexual acts.
Material that promotes or enables real-world harm. Prevention and educational content can still be classified based on wording and model.
Block low, medium, and high probability

Server default uses the model or endpoint default. The standard Gemini API rates the probability that content belongs to a category. Below the selected threshold, this category does not block the content. No block by category rating can still return ratings when supported. With the filter off, supported endpoints typically omit these ratings. Availability varies by model or endpoint. A different category or a mandatory safeguard can still block a request or reply. New ZeroAgent provider configurations use Off until you choose another setting.
